text:
Marta: Heads-up — I found an invoice issue that will impact month-end revenue. Invoice RWI-4521 (sent 2025-10-01) billed a $120,000 prepaid Dedicated commit but our accounting export shows the entire amount mapped to Sep revenue instead of being deferred over the service period. Need quick eyes for a deferral schedule and JE before close.
Liam: Which contract term? is it 3 months or more? :eyes:
Marta: Contract (ACME-2025-DED) is Sep 1 - Nov 30 (3 months). Sales coded it as prepaid and invoice shows "Prepaid Dedicated - 2025Q3" line. GL mapped to 4001 erroneously (Revenue) not 2190 (Deferred Revenue).
Oscar: Oof. Do we have the invoice PDF? can you paste the invoice line exactly?
Marta: Pasting the line from the billing CSV: "RWI-4521,ACME-2025-DED,Prepaid Dedicated,120000,USD,2025-09-01,2025-11-30,recognize_monthly". Attached to the thread in Jira but pasting here too.
Priya: Is this customer on an annual commitment or explicitly 3-month reserved? affects recognition pattern (equal monthly deferral vs pro rata by days).
Marta: It's explicitly a 3-month reserved commit with even monthly service. Sales confirmed equal-month pattern.
Liam: Ok — propose deferral schedule: defer $40,000 per month for Sep/Oct/Nov. We need a reversing JE to move GL 4001 -> 2190 and then monthly recognition entries.
Marta: Can you draft the JE we should ask AP/GL to post? I can request approvals once you confirm.
Liam: Draft JE (to post effective 2025-09-01, reversing entries on 2025-10-01 and 2025-11-01 as part of month-end):
```
Date: 2025-09-30
DR Sales Revenue (GL 4001) : 120,000
CR Deferred Revenue (GL 2190): 120,000

Then monthly recognition (on 10/01, 11/01, 12/01 depending on how book wants it) — but for our case since service is Sep-Nov, recognition lines:
2025-09-30 Recognize 40,000 from 2190 -> 4001
DR Deferred Revenue (2190): 40,000
CR Sales Revenue (4001): 40,000
(repeat Oct & Nov)
```
Marta: Minor note — we should tag this with revenue schedule code REV-SCH-DED-2025-09 so reporting picks it up.
rev-bot: Automated note: Contract ACME-2025-DED flagged for manual revenue schedule assignment. Ticket #RWI-ACC-891 created.
Oscar: OK. Two controls: 1) use REV-SCH-DED-2025-09 as Marta said, 2) include contract ID in the JE description: "RWI-4521 / ACME-2025-DED deferral".
Priya: Do we need CFO approval for a manual reclassification of this size? it's $120k but within monthly adjustment thresholds?
Liam: It's below the $250k threshold for CFO explicit sign-off. Finance manager approval + accounting ops is sufficient. I'll approve if you add the JE comment and schedule code.
Marta: I'm going to request AP to post the reversing entry today and set up the three monthly recognizes. Copying the exact JE text above into the ticket. @Liam can you drop a :thumbsup: when you approve?
Liam: :thumbsup: Approved. Please include the following metadata in the ticket: external_invoice=RWI-4521, contract=ACME-2025-DED, rev_schedule=REV-SCH-DED-2025-09, accounting_periods=[2025-09,2025-10,2025-11], JE_owner=accounting-ops.
Marta: Added metadata and CC'd accounting-ops. AP asked if they should use a suspense account first or post direct — what's your call?
Oscar: Post direct to 2190 then track via schedule. Suspense will create extra cleanup work.
Marta: Noted. I'll tell AP to post direct.
rev-bot: Update: Ticket RWI-ACC-891 status changed to "awaiting-AP-post" at 2025-10-01T14:12:00Z.
Priya: Do we want a permanent fix in billing mapping so future prepaid Dedicated invoices map to 2190 automatically?
Liam: Yes — file a mapping change request with Billing Engineering. @Oscar can you take that? we should verify both invoice templates and the extraction pipeline.
Oscar: On it. I'll open a mapping PR and include unit tests for invoice type -> GL mapping. ETA: end of week.
Marta: Thanks team — will update this thread when AP confirms JE posted. Closing loop before month close.
rev-bot: Note: Monthly revenue reports will reflect change after next ETL run."
